identity.title: [provider] Add first-class Moonshot/Kimi K3 provider support

values.summary: Implemented first-class Moonshot/Kimi K3 provider support in the bound issue worktree. The change adds native kimi/moonshot provider-kind routing, the kimi:k3 profile, Kimi setup generation, bounded provider documentation, runtime adapter reasoning_effort propagation, and issue-owned deterministic tests. Integration remains worktree-only pending exact review and PR publication.
actual_changes: Added native Kimi/Moonshot provider support in adl/src/provider/http_family.rs and wired it through adl/src/provider/mod.rs.
Added kimi:k3 profile materialization and reasoning_effort validation in adl/src/provider/profiles.rs.
Canonicalized moonshot as a Kimi provider alias in adl/src/provider_substrate.rs.
Propagated Kimi runtime-adapter reasoning_effort in adl/src/provider_adapter.rs and validated Kimi K3 reasoning values in adl/src/provider_communication.rs.
Added adl provider setup kimi/moonshot support in adl/src/cli/provider_cmd.rs and adl/src/cli/usage.rs.
Added issue-owned integration test target adl/tests/provider_moonshot_kimi_k3.rs.

actual_validation.purpose: Focused issue-owned Moonshot/Kimi K3 provider integration proof.
Strict lint proof for touched Rust provider surfaces.
Rust formatting check for touched sources and tests.
